info.name: TurboLedger — Phase 2 (Organization & SystemConfig)
info.description:
Phase 2 surface through the API Gateway: offices, office transactions, staff, holidays, working days, currencies, funds, payment types, entity-to-entity mapping, taxes (Organization service) plus codes, global configuration, external service credentials, audits, hooks, caches, business date, external events, field configuration, datatables, entity-datatable checks, imports, and entity documents/notes/images/calendars/meetings (SystemConfig service).

Run the '0 - Auth' request first (requires a tenant/admin already provisioned, e.g. via the Phase 1 collection) to populate {{token}}. Collection variables: baseUrl (default http://127.0.0.1:7499), tenantId, token.

Request bodies were auto-derived from the actual field reads in OrganizationService.cc / SystemConfigService.cc (asStringOr/asBoolOr/asDoubleOr/asIntOr calls) so example payloads use real field names; placeholder values are generic and should be adjusted to valid data for your environment.
